headline: Bestex (Thailand) Co., Ltd. Addresses Cybersecurity Breach
body: Bestex (Thailand) Co., Ltd. has publicly addressed the recent ransomware attack that compromised its internal data systems. As a key supplier in the automotive industry, Bestex is collaborating with external cybersecurity specialists to investigate the breach. The company has not reported any downstream effects or customer impacts, emphasizing its commitment to maintaining operational stability and data security.
